decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the retention of a flank extension to this dwellinghouse , because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of number 4 Woodlands Road and is complementary to the visual amenity of the locality and would not be detrimental to the amenities of adjoining and neighbouring properties and would serve to preserve the character of the Conservation Area.  The development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B 1.1 (New Development) ENV B 2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
description: Retention of a single storey side extension to ground floor flat
